name: Beached Sea Turtle
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago.  It has been picked nearly clean by Greymist murlocs, the very ones who now have encamped themselves around the creature's remains.  Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
narrative.objectives: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've found even more beached creatures, adventurer?  Sea turtles were commonly found frolicking along the base of Nordrassil before it was destroyed.  With the birth of Teldrassil, however, these creatures have been seen in ever decreasing numbers.  Some, as we have discovered, end their lives here for some unknown reason.

Your aid will perhaps unlock the mystery before us.  Please accept this in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings once again adventurer - do you have any more discoveries to report to the Temple of the Moon?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 13 to 19, 2,375 XP in all.

quests.name: Washed Ashore
quests.objectiveText: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

quests.name: Washed Ashore
quests.objectiveText: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.

quests.objectiveText: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
